adjudication.rationale: The diff verifiably removes the ability to create a group with initial members in a single save: `Discourse.Group.asJSON()` now returns only `{name, alias_level, visible}` and the previous `createWithUsernames/saveWithUsernames` methods are removed; `create()`/`save()` POST/PUT only that payload (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js). The admin template now shows the add-members UI only inside `{{#if id}}` (app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs), so on a brand-new group you must first create/save to get an id, then do a separate `addMembers` PUT. The prior spec coverage asserting create-with-usernames is also removed, and new specs don’t cover initial membership on create (spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb). This is a concrete, diff-grounded functional/UX regression and missing coverage, though not a hard correctness failure since members can still be added after creation.
